_comment: Static site assets (not article heroes) that CI localises into the repo. The authoring sandbox is blocked from the image CDN, so we record the remote URL here and scripts/localise-hero-images.mjs downloads it into `path` on push (GitHub runners have open internet). Idempotent: an asset whose `path` already exists is skipped.

assets.note: Homepage masthead found-footage still / video poster — faint black-triangle craft with 3 lights in fog, AI-generated (Higgsfield nano_banana_pro, 16:9).
